note: Twin of logical/alias-diff-holdings: an alias window that replaces its state's column in 2019 (Value -> Different) is a change, in holdings as in reference. Typed's per-column 2019 window changes its type and width (integer 8 -> varchar 20), and holdings, which does not hold Typed, leaves it out. Fails if diff compares raw states instead of the expanded representations, a type or width change goes unreported, or holdings counts an unheld variable.
